scope: Real TalkBack focus and double-tap gestures, native recording and cancellation on the Android 16 emulator. Host audio disabled; no audibility, live speech or full accessibility acceptance.

checks.name: Actual TalkBack and its offline English voice are active; the saved hold preference is overridden by accessible tap mode

TalkBack gestures reach and activate Cancel; capture stops, cached audio is removed, and no upload is sent
